project.name: backendcodeladder
project.description: CodeLadder Competitive Programming Platform REST API and Intelligence Service

features.name: Authentication & Identity Management
features.purpose: Issues and verifies JWT session tokens with dual-header validation (Bearer token + X-Username).
knownEdgeCases: Dual-header matching: Token payload username must match X-Username header.
Automatic admin promotion for usernames deepanshu and admin.
Test suite in tests/api.test.js expects user without id property.
knownIssues: Token revocation via tokenVersion field on User model. POST /api/auth/logout-all increments it.
JWT_EXPIRES_IN defaults to 1d (reduced from 7d).
Admin seeding: use npm run seed:admin with ADMIN_SEED_USERNAME/EMAIL/PASSWORD env vars.
Account lockout: HTTP 429 after MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS failures for LOCK_DURATION_MINUTES.
Password strength enforced on registration: >=8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, digit.
Timing-safe login: dummy bcrypt compare when username not found.
JWT_SECRET must be >= 32 chars (startup-enforced).

features.name: In-Memory Question Catalog & Problem Search
features.purpose: Provides sub-millisecond filtering, pagination, and tag taxonomy normalization across 22,000+ CP questions.
knownEdgeCases: Junk tags are filtered out using isJunkTag regex; tag aliases are mapped canonically (e.g. dynamic programming -> dp).
Non-ObjectId slugs are resolved dynamically to ObjectIds in middleware/validateObjectId.js.

features.name: User Progress & Global Question State
features.purpose: Tracks global solve timestamps, first solve dates, and starred bookmarks per user across platforms.
knownEdgeCases: solve() and unsolve() currently throw HTTP 403 because manual solving was locked in favor of account sync.
2-minute freeze rule logic limits manual unsolve requests to within 120s of initial solve.
knownIssues: solve() and unsolve() now return HTTP 501 Not Implemented. Use sync-solved instead.
UserQuestionState.verified: Boolean (default: false)
UserQuestionState.verificationMethod: enum [LEETCODE_CHALLENGE, CODEFORCES_API, SCRAPE, MANUAL_UNVERIFIED, UNVERIFIED]
Compound index { userId: 1, verified: 1 } added.

features.name: Ladders & Curated Practice Sheets
features.purpose: Creates, organizes, reorders, publishes, and discovers problem ladders, including default sheets (Blind 75, NeetCode 150, CP-31, CF Div 2).
knownEdgeCases: User quota: maximum 10 personal ladders per user.
Public quota: maximum 10 published ladders per user. Publishing is irreversible.
Default ladders (IDs starting with default-) resolve in-memory via services/defaultLadders.js.

features.name: Ladder Practice & Revision Mode
features.purpose: Tracks blind problem solving per ladder and calculates review queues for revision mode.
knownEdgeCases: Ladder mode enum is ['NORMAL', 'REVISION']. Revision questions are filtered by practiced state.

features.name: Ladder Collaboration & Access Control
features.purpose: Manages member invitations and permissions (READ vs WRITE) on private and team ladders.
knownEdgeCases: Ladder owners cannot invite themselves. Roles are strictly READ or WRITE.

features.name: Codeforces-Style Community Blogs & Comments
features.purpose: Full-featured markdown blogs with LaTeX math formulas, code blocks, comment upvotes, and real-time recent actions.
knownEdgeCases: Quota: maximum 5 blogs per user.
Content size limit: 50,000 characters per blog; 5,000 per comment.
Voting toggles off on secondary click and enforces 2-minute freeze rule.
knownIssues: sanitizeInput() strips <script>, on*= attributes, javascript: URIs from blog title/content/comment on create+update.
MAX_COMMENTS_PER_BLOG = 500 enforced in addComment().
createBlog response now includes content field.

features.name: Platform Account Integration & Solve Synchronization
features.purpose: Links external CP handles (LeetCode, Codeforces, CodeChef, AtCoder), verifies handles, and bulk syncs solve history.
knownEdgeCases: syncSolvedProblems accepts bulk arrays up to 10MB JSON payloads.
LeetCode challenge generates a random verification code that must be submitted to LeetCode.
knownIssues: syncSolvedProblems: per-platform cap 2000, total cap 5000. HTTP 400 if exceeded.
Codeforces: live CF API verification if handle linked (CODEFORCES_API vs UNVERIFIED).
LeetCode: LEETCODE_CHALLENGE if verified account, else UNVERIFIED.
CodeChef/AtCoder: always UNVERIFIED.
Response includes verifiedCount and unverifiedCount.
LC slug matching uses both lowercase and original-case externalIds.
LeetCode challenge verification requires code containing auth token.

features.name: Multi-Platform Contest Upsolving
features.purpose: Provides contest directories and problem specifications across Codeforces, LeetCode, and CodeChef.
knownEdgeCases: Platform and category fields are unconstrained uppercase strings (no enum) to accommodate new contest formats.
Contest problems link to Question collection via questionId when matched.

features.name: Public User Profiles & Heatmap Statistics
features.purpose: Aggregates annual solve heatmaps, contributed public ladders, blogs, and total community upvotes for public profiles.
knownEdgeCases: Calculates grand total upvotes by summing ladder likes and blog upvotes.

features.name: Administrative Operations
features.purpose: Restricted administration dashboard for user account management, password resets, ladder moderation, and bulk problem seeding.
knownEdgeCases: Deleting a user cascades deletions across their personal ladders, memberships, practice records, and question states.
knownIssues: Audit log written to auditlogs collection before deleteUser() and deleteLadder().

features.name: Diagnostics & Health Check
features.purpose: Reports API service availability and MongoDB connectivity status.
knownEdgeCases: Strict equality assertion in tests/api.test.js expects { ok: true, service: 'codeladder-api' } without database payload.
knownIssues: Returns HTTP 200 with { ok, service, database: { connected, host, name, readyState } } when connected.
Returns HTTP 503 with { ok: false, database: { connected: false } } when disconnected.

directories.role: Business logic implementations decoupled from HTTP routing.
Pre-packaged dataset seed files for bootstrap and offline catalog operations.
Express request pipeline filters, security checks, and rate limiters.
Mongoose schemas, validation rules, and collection indices.
Express route definitions mapping HTTP paths to controllers and middlewares.
Database maintenance, synchronization, and ETL utilities.
Application-wide domain services and caching layers (questionCatalog, defaultLadders).
Automated integration tests using Jest and Supertest.

internalCoupling.reason: Resolves non-ObjectId slugs to ObjectIds dynamically.
Hydrates problem metadata for default curated sheets.
Serves default- prefixed ladders without database queries.

flows.name: User Authentication Flow
steps: Client sends request with Authorization: Bearer <jwt> and X-Username headers
app.js generalLimiter throttles request if limit exceeded
middleware/auth.js verifies JWT signature and validates username match
models/User.js is queried to attach req.user { id, username, role }
Target route controller executes business logic

flows.name: Question Catalog Search Flow
steps: Client sends GET /api/questions with search query, tags, and rating filters
services/questionCatalog.js performs in-memory filter, slice, and tag count in < 2ms
JSON response returns questions array with pagination metadata

flows.name: Platform Solve State Synchronization Flow
steps: Client sends POST /api/platform-accounts/sync-solved with solved problem titles/slugs
controllers/platformAccountController.js maps slugs to question IDs via questionCatalog
models/UserQuestionState.js executes bulkWrite upsert for solved: true
PlatformAccount.lastSyncedAt timestamp is refreshed in database

changelog.title: Security Hardening Pass
changes: S1: CORS whitelist via ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var
S2+S9: helmet() — HTTP security headers, X-Powered-By removed
S3: Account lockout (loginAttempts, lockUntil on User model)
S4: Body limit 100kb default; 10mb only for sync-solved
S5: syncSolvedLimiter (5 req / 10 min)
S6: Safe error logging — no stack in production
S7: JWT_SECRET >= 32 chars enforced at startup
S8: Custom mongoSanitize middleware (Express 5 compatible)
S10: Password strength regex + timing-safe dummy bcrypt
S11: hpp() HTTP Parameter Pollution guard
S12: Health endpoint redacts DB host/port/name in production
S13: requestId middleware — X-Request-Id UUID header
S14: Rate limiters active in all envs except test
New files: middleware/requestId.js, middleware/mongoSanitize.js
New packages: helmet, hpp
Tests: 75/75 passing

Added POST /api/platform-accounts/codechef/sync

security.headers: helmet() — sets HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, removes X-Powered-By
security.cors: Whitelist-based via ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var. Empty = allow all (dev). Production requires explicit origins.
security.mongoInjection: middleware/mongoSanitize.js strips $ and . prefixed keys from body and params
security.requestId: middleware/requestId.js — UUID per request, X-Request-Id header
